description: This file defines service functions for managing and retrieving component nodes in a server application, including fetching all nodes, nodes by category or name, node icons, async options, and executing custom functions.

methods.name: getAllNodes
methods.description: Retrieves all component nodes from the running Express app.

methods.name: getAllNodesForCategory
methods.description: Retrieves all component nodes belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getNodeByName
methods.description: Fetches a specific component node by its name.

methods.name: getSingleNodeIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon filepath for a specific node, verifying its existence and format.

methods.name: getSingleNodeAsyncOptions
methods.description: Fetches asynchronous options for a node based on provided request data.

methods.name: executeCustomFunction
methods.description: Executes a custom node function, either via queue or directly, based on environment mode.
